blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo bounced back in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament by trouncing Adamson, 73-68, at Mall of Asia Arena on Saturday. After a lopsided loss to the University of the Philippines last week, the Blue Eagles improved to 2-1. Getting there, however, was far from a cakewalk. “Every team here is capable of beating the other teams. You have to go to these games well-prepared, especially against a well-coached Adamson team,” coach Louie Alas admitted. “In this game, it was low-scoring and I like this because as they said, […]...
